description:
Become a part of our caring community 
 
The AV Technical Ops & Production Engineer supports Humana's live events, video production, livestreams, and AV systems. This role serves as a primary technical owner for AV Services production environments, ensuring studios, control rooms, livestream systems, mobile production equipment, and event technologies remain reliable, current, and ready to support critical business communications.
This role is both hands-on and technical. Responsibilities include supporting productions, maintaining equipment, troubleshooting issues, managing inventory, and designing and deploying AV systems for onsite and offsite events.
The person in this role serves as one of the lead technical resources for offsite AV event systems, supporting company meetings, leadership events, conferences, and special productions. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Production and Technical Support 
 Support live events, video production, and livestreams
 Serve as a primary technical resource and first point of escalation for production system issues
 Troubleshoot and resolve AV system issues
 Perform maintenance, upgrades, testing, and installations
 Maintain operational readiness of studios, control rooms, and mobile event systems
 Provide backup support for audio, video, and livestream production
 Partner with IT, facilities, vendors, and event stakeholders on production technology initiatives
 Studio and Control Room Support 
 Serve as lead technician for:
 Video studios
 Town Hall control rooms
 Livestream production spaces
 Audio recording and podcast spaces
 Set up, operate, maintain, and troubleshoot production equipment including:
 Video switchers
 Cameras and PTZ cameras
 Audio consoles and DSP systems
 Intercom systems
 Streaming and encoding tools
 Signal routing systems
 Studio lighting
 Recording and playback systems
 Production platforms and software tools such as Adobe Creative Suite and DaVinci Resolve
 Test systems prior to major events and productions
 Offsite Event Support 
 Design, build, maintain, and support offsite AV systems, flypacks, and mobile production environments
 Prepare, transport, install, operate, and recover equipment for events
 Keep mobile production systems organized, tested, and deployment ready
 Support redundancy planning and risk mitigation for critical events
 Event System Design and Installation 
 Lead technical planning and implementation for meetings, conferences, and special events
 Design workflows for audio, video, streaming, networking, and presentations
 Conduct venue assessments and site visits as needed
 Create equipment lists, signal flow diagrams, and floor plans
 Lead setup and technical implementation prior to events
 Act as the primary technical escalation point during setup and event execution
 Inventory and Asset Management 
 Own and manage AV production inventory
 Track equipment utilization, repairs, maintenance, warranties, and replacement needs
 Conduct regular audits to ensure equipment readiness
 Manage spare equipment and redundancy planning
 Recommend equipment replacements, upgrades, standardization opportunities, and technology improvements
 What Makes Someone Successful in This Role 
 The ideal candidate:
 Has strong AV technical knowledge and production experience
 Enjoys working with technology and solving problems
 Has a strong customer service mindset
 Communicates well and works effectively with others
 Can work independently with minimal supervision
 Pays close attention to detail
 Demonstrates sound judgment and proactively identifies risks, issues, and improvement opportunities
 Identifies ways to modernize systems and improve reliability
 
 Use your skills to make an impact 
 
 Required Experience 
 5+ years supporting professional AV, broadcast, live event production, or production engineering environments
 Experience designing, deploying, operating, and supporting enterprise livestream, broadcast, or event production equipment and systems
 Preferred Production experience and certifications: 
 Technical Direction
 Audio Operation/Mixing
 Live Camera Operation (PTZ and EFP)
 Lighting Control Operation & Programming (DMX)
 Experience managing AV inventory and equipment lifecycle programs
 Experience supporting mobile production environments and flypack systems
 CTS or CTS-D, Dante, Crestron, Extron, Q-SYS, or equivalent technical certifications
 Broadcast, streaming, or production engineering certifications
 DMX Training & Certification
 Additional Information 
 This role is only open to applicants located in Louisville, Kentucky and will primarily be an in-office position.
 Travel up to 25% may be required. Travel may include equipment transport, venue assessments, event setup, onsite technical leadership, and production support for meetings, leadership events, conferences, productions, and special events.
 Valid driver's license and clean driving record required.
 
 
  
  
 
 Scheduled Weekly Hours 
 
40 
 Pay Range 
The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc. 
 
$78,400 - $107,800 per year 
 
This job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance. 
 Description of Benefits 
Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities. 
 
 
 About Us 
 
About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.
